remarks: Compo Beach, Westport - now available as a full-year rental. Experience the magic of waterfront living at this beautifully furnished 3-bedroom, 2 full and 2 half bath retreat, where sunrises and moonrises paint the sky from a stunning rooftop deck with wide, unobstructed views of Long Island Sound.  Designed for both comfort and serenity, the home offers a peaceful, zen-like atmosphere ideal for year-round living. Enjoy fireside evenings on the back porch, relaxed mornings by the water, and effortless indoor-outdoor living in one of Westport's most coveted beachside neighborhoods.  Just steps to Compo Beach, this exceptional property invites you to embrace every season-from summer beach days to crisp coastal walks and cozy winter gatherings. Conveniently located near Westport's vibrant shopping, dining, and cultural amenities.  Furnished | Private fire pit | Spectacular rooftop deck with water views   Offered at $20,000/month for a 12-month term.
